studies.title: EU steel decarbonisation
studies.summary: Compare low-carbon steelmaking routes and their environmental and market implications in Europe.

publication.title: Assessing environmental and market implications of steel decarbonisation strategies: a hybrid input-output model for the European union

studies.contribution: Adds steelmaking and hydrogen technologies to a hybrid supply-use database and evaluates technology-penetration scenarios for the EU.
studies.scope: European steel production; carbon footprints and prices under alternative steel and electricity mixes.
studies.data_lineage: EXIOBASE Hybrid, with EU aggregation, electricity updating and dedicated steel and hydrogen inventories. This is the earlier EU study in the steel modelling line.

editions.label: Study archive and source
editions.scope: Database preparation, scenario analysis and plotting scripts accompany the 2024 study.
editions.limitations: The catalog records the inspected source revision. Its equivalence to the archived code and the published figures has not been independently checked.

studies.title: GCAM–MARIO steel scenarios
studies.summary: Link GCAM technology pathways with hybrid input-output footprints for European steel policy.

publication.title: Linking Global Integrated Assessment and Hybrid Input–Output Models To Support Steel Decarbonization Policies in Europe

studies.contribution: Couples integrated assessment scenarios with technology-specific supply-chain accounting to examine steel decarbonisation policies.
studies.scope: Baseline, CBAM and subsidy scenarios; steel and electricity pathways, GHG and energy footprints.
studies.data_lineage: Uses an extended EXIOBASE Hybrid steel database. The paper cites the Green steel archive; the later coupling example explicitly pins version 1.3.0.

editions.label: Original study scripts

data.label: Database archive cited by the paper
GCAM version cited by the paper

editions.scope: Original database-building, GCAM preparation, shock and result-processing scripts.
editions.limitations: The scripts require external files and local path configuration. Full paper reproduction and the exact archived database edition remain to be verified.

editions.label: Executable coupling example
editions.scope: Reads GCAM exports and applies electricity and steel mix changes to a teaching database or the extended EXIOBASE source.
editions.limitations: This development example preserves background demand and trade. It demonstrates the coupling mechanism and does not reproduce all study scenarios or figures.

studies.title: Solar PV reshoring
studies.summary: Assess the environmental and socio-economic effects of moving photovoltaic supply chains to Europe.

publication.title: Environmental and socio-economic implications of solar photovoltaic reshoring under the EU Net Zero Industry Act: a hybrid input-output assessment

studies.contribution: Embeds an explicit photovoltaic supply chain in a hybrid supply-use model and varies sourcing, technology and performance assumptions.
studies.scope: Carbon footprints, prices, production, value added and employment; reshoring scenarios and parameter sensitivity.
studies.data_lineage: Builds on the Green steel modelling line, then adapts the database and regional aggregation for PV. This is a study-specific extension, not a replacement release of the steel database.

editions.label: Archived PV release · 1.0.1

data.label: PV code and data archive · v1.0.1

editions.scope: Fixed archive linked to the PV study.
editions.limitations: Use the archived environment and inputs when comparing this edition with the paper.

editions.label: Documented reconstruction
editions.scope: Notebook, command-line pipeline, scenario configuration and baseline comparison.
editions.limitations: The repository states that rebuilding from the downloadable background is not bit-identical to the original results. Use its reference outputs and stated tolerances.

studies.title: Sufficiency in a decarbonising Europe
studies.summary: Assess household sufficiency measures alongside changes in the European energy system.

publication.title: The role of sufficiency measures in a decarbonizing Europe

studies.contribution: Combines sufficiency measures with a changing production background to calculate environmental and socio-economic effects.
studies.scope: Household-demand scenarios, greenhouse gases, value added and employment.
studies.data_lineage: The database-building notebook starts from EXIOBASE Hybrid v3.3.18 and applies its own aggregation and extensions. Compatibility with current NXSUT has not been established.

editions.label: FULFILL study workflow
editions.scope: Three sequential notebooks build the database, prepare shocks and run the scenarios.
editions.limitations: The exact version-specific data record still needs to be identified within the archive linked by the source README.

studies.title: Sufficiency and EU climate targets
studies.summary: Examine the contribution of sufficiency to the EU’s 2030 and 2050 greenhouse-gas targets.

publication.title: Impact of sufficiency on achieving the EU's 2030 and 2050 greenhouse gas emissions targets

studies.contribution: A separate publication in the sufficiency research programme, with its own assumptions and results.
studies.data_lineage: The exact code and data edition for this publication still needs to be identified. The FULFILL repository is related work, not a verified reproduction source for this paper.

editions.label: Study resources to identify
editions.limitations: No code or dataset is presented here as the verified source of these published results.

studies.title: Electricity carbon intensity
studies.summary: Compare electricity emission factors and explain differences between data sources and accounting methods.

publication.title: Carbon intensity of electricity: a systematic methodological and quantitative review

studies.contribution: Compares technology and national electricity intensities across input-output databases and other sources, with attention to system boundaries and conversion to physical units.
studies.scope: Electricity technologies and national mixes; direct and life-cycle greenhouse-gas intensities.
studies.data_lineage: The analysis uses several databases, including monetary and hybrid tables. Its model structure is deliberately independent of a single common background database.

editions.label: Comparison pipeline
editions.scope: Notebook and helpers for calculating and comparing electricity footprints.
editions.limitations: Source database access and local paths must be configured before running the notebook.

foundations.title: EXIOBASE Hybrid
foundations.description: Historical starting point for the steel, PV and FULFILL workflows. Each study applies its own aggregation, extensions and reference years.

foundations.title: Green steel extensions
foundations.description: The EU steel study develops into broader steel and hydrogen extensions. The GCAM example pins version 1.3.0; the documented PV reconstruction uses version 1.3.2.

foundations.title: NXSUT
foundations.description: A maintained hybrid supply-use database with updated electricity and steel modelling. Version 3.0 is a possible background for future editions; no study in this gallery is claimed to have been reproduced on it.
